post.description:
Render a fully custom animation from a Remotion React component (TSX). The code must `export default` a React component; it may import from 'react', 'remotion' (AbsoluteFill, Sequence, Series, useCurrentFrame, useVideoConfig, interpolate, spring, Easing, Img, Audio, staticFile), '@remotion/transitions' (+ /fade /slide /wipe /flip), '@remotion/shapes', '@remotion/paths', '@remotion/noise'. Use the 'Vazirmatn' font for Persian. Input files are available via staticFile('in/<file name>') or by passing their ids in props. No network inside the renderer (no remote URLs). Max 60 s (30 s at 1080p). Queued like animation_render.

Price (api, default plan): ~3,000 toman per call. Timeout 900s. Runs asynchronously: returns a job_id unless ?wait=N seconds is given.

parameters.description: Seconds to wait for async jobs before returning the job_id
parameters.name: wait

post.description:
Render an animated video (MP4/WebM/GIF) from scenes: title, text (word-by-word), bullets, image (Ken Burns), quote, stat (animated counter), chart (animated bars), steps, split (image+text), cta — with transitions (fade/slide/wipe/flip), theme, logo, background music and watermark. Persian RTL with the Vazirmatn font by default. Aspect 16:9, 9:16 (stories/reels), 1:1 or 4:5. Max 20 scenes; total length max 30 s at 1080p, 60 s at 720p (default), 120 s at 480p. Rendering is queued (one render at a time) and returns a job_id; the user is notified.

Price (api, default plan): ~2,400 toman per call. Timeout 900s. Runs asynchronously: returns a job_id unless ?wait=N seconds is given.
